overview: Applies kernel sysctl tuning recommended for K3s hosts — inotify limits, ip_forward, somaxconn, and vm.max_map_count. Shows all values and asks for confirmation before writing /etc/sysctl.d/99-himosoft.conf.
prerequisites: Recommended on Server A before K3s install

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-system-tune

steps.title: Review and apply
steps.body: Displays proposed sysctl values. Nothing is changed until you confirm.

commands.description: Show settings and apply after confirm

notes: Safe to re-run — overwrites the same file
